| feature group / column                                               | used     | time of information                | n features   | examples                                                                      | why                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
|:---------------------------------------------------------------------|:---------|:-----------------------------------|:-------------|:------------------------------------------------------------------------------|:---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| lag_aqi                                                              | YES      | days D-29..D                       | 16           | aqi_l0, aqi_l1, aqi_l2, aqi_l3, aqi_l4 ...                                    | Past AQI only (lags 0-6, trailing windows ending at D). AQI(D) is complete at 24:00 of D. Gaps filled causally (same-day neighbours, forward-fill <= 3 calendar days); remaining gaps use the fold-fitted climatology.                                                                       |
| lag_poll                                                             | YES      | days D-6..D                        | 24           | PM25_mean_l0, PM10_mean_l0, NO2_mean_l0, SO2_mean_l0, CO_8h_l0 ...            | Pollutant daily means/8-h maxima and intraday shape of day D. They are inputs to AQI, but of day D, not D+1.                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| missing                                                              | YES      | day D                              | 9            | PM25_nh_l0, PM10_nh_l0, aqi_nsub_l0, miss_aqi_l0, miss_aqi_7d ...             | Valid-hour counts and raw missing flags of day D (taken BEFORE any fill); sensor gaps are informative.                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| spatial                                                              | YES      | day D                              | 6            | city_aqi_l0, city_pm25_l0, state_aqi_l0, city_nst_l0, city_aqi_rm3 ...        | AQI/PM2.5 of OTHER stations in the same (state, city) / state on day D. Their D+1 values are NOT used.                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| met_site                                                             | YES      | day D                              | 9            | site_WS_l0, site_RH_l0, site_AT_l0, site_SR_l0, site_BP_l0 ...                | OBSERVED weather from the station's own CPCB sensors for day D; reported live, so available at issue time.                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Weather of the target day D+1 (observed)                             | EXCLUDED | day D+1                            | -            | nan                                                                           | Observed future weather = leakage for a true forecast; no weather-forecast input is used.                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ERA5 reanalysis (any day)                                            | NOT USED | -                                  | -            | nan                                                                           | Published ~5 days after real time, so even day-D values would not exist at 24:00 of D.                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| fire                                                                 | YES      | available by 24:00 of D            | 6            | fire_100km_l0, fire_300km_l0, frp_300km_l0, fire_300km_rm3, fire_PB_HR_l0 ... | NASA FIRMS MODIS detections dated in IST from the UTC acquisition time, plus a 3-h near-real-time latency. The standard-quality-only `type` field is not used. Archive locations are the standard product (retrospective study); counts use fields that the near-real-time product also has. |
| calendar                                                             | YES      | day D+1                            | 8            | doy_sin, doy_cos, month, dow, weekend ...                                     | Day of year/week, Diwali distance, lockdown flag of D+1: known in advance.                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| static                                                               | YES      | -                                  | 5            | lat, lon, elevation, region_code, clim_aqi_month                              | Coordinates, elevation, region; clim_aqi_month is fitted per fold on that fold's training rows (leave-one-year-out for training rows, so a row's own target never enters its feature).                                                                                                       |
| AQI(D+1), AQI_cat, AQI_driver, sub-indices SI_* of D+1               | EXCLUDED | day D+1                            | -            | nan                                                                           | Deterministic function of the target day's pollutant concentrations: hands the model the answer.                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Pollutant concentrations of D+1 (PM2.5, PM10, NO2, SO2, CO, O3, NH3) | EXCLUDED | day D+1                            | -            | nan                                                                           | Inputs of the target AQI: not available when the forecast is issued.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| y_pm25 (PM2.5 of D+1)                                                | EXCLUDED | day D+1                            | -            | nan                                                                           | Kept for diagnostics only, never a feature.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Centred rolling windows / two-sided interpolation                    | NOT USED | -                                  | -            | nan                                                                           | All windows are trailing; linear interpolation appears only as an offline reference in the imputation study.                                                                                                                                                                                 |
